Name: Deborah, Core Systems, Story Engine & Combat Logic

This game was inspired by the historical journey of the Oregon Trail, reflecting
the challenges, decisions, and survival strategies faced by 19th-century pioneers.
It recreates key elements such as resource management, disease, travel risks, and environmental
hardships to provide an immersive experience. While simplified, it highlights both the ambition
and struggles of westward expansion and the concept of Manifest Destiny. The game also acknowledges
the broader historical context, including its impact on Indigenous peoples and the environment.
